prerequisites: Have first management experiences in companies (internship) or in the context of personal activities (sport, association...)

learning_outcomes.text: Listen and understand the expectations of their interlocutors (employees, colleagues and managers).
Apprehend a conflict and get out of it.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: The rules of «Plus Belle la Vie Ensemble» to ensure everyone’s psychological safety
Introduction: Status of initial knowledge and beliefs of students
Introduction: The role of the manager and the importance of the human dimension
Introduction: Motivation factors and expectations of students in this teaching
Introduction: The content of the training and the areas covered
Introduction: The organization and work required between each session
Manager 3.0: Management basics and beliefs to brush away
Manager 3.0: Current expectations of employees and managers
Manager 3.0: The 3 current challenges of the manager 3.0
Self-assessment: Its sensory perception mode and the consequences on its communication mode
Self-assessment: Transactional analysis profile (Parent – Child – Adult)
Self-assessment: Management styles specific to each generation
Self-assessment: The incentives available in companies
Situational Management: The 4 management styles and their importance
Situational Management: His preferred management style
Situational Management: The style adapted to the mission and to the person
Situational Management: Towards more autonomy and confidence: the progressive and regressive cycles
Active listening: The 6 attitudes of Porter
Active listening: Test your ability to practice active listening and debrief on the feelings
Active listening: The tools supporting active listening (reformulation, reflection, emotions and adapted responses...)
Meeting Conduct: The interests and pitfalls of a meeting: what is the point?

Summary: Reminder on concepts discussed
Summary: Evaluation of training by students
Summary: Instructions for the duty
Summary: Acknowledgements
assessment_rules: The evaluation formula is 1*DS1, meaning the final exam accounts for 100% of the grade.
